CommunityApplications.Profile: Vora Templates — Community Applications templates for Vora, a self-hosted media server for movies, TV, music, and IPTV with DVR and AI-assisted discovery, with cinematic clients for Android, Android TV, Fire TV, Roku, and the web. This repository provides the Vora Media Server container. Vora requires a PostgreSQL database with the pgvector extension, available as the pgvector app already in Community Applications. Support is handled through GitHub Discussions (Q&A) and Issues on the project repository.
